name: Flat chicken leg
summary: Flat roasted chicken drumstick with golden-brown skin and bone end. For roast, picnic or fried chicken scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the drumstick rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~340 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in
